problem_summary: 20 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in A Narayanapura between January 2019 and July 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 60% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 78 pothole complaints.
43 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹61.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).
Ward recorded 106 road crashes in 2024, of which 17 were fatal.

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 60% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
agency_attribution_note: 19 of 20 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier HIGH (score=0.66). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, crash_risk=1.00, complaint_volume=0.67.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='A Narayanapura' matched to datameet243=90 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.641).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for A Narayanapura for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 43 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
